subject: Pilot: integration adapter freeze — request for sandbox hours & trial extension
messages:
From: Dana White <dana.white@nebulatech.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: integration adapter freeze — request for sandbox hours & trial extension

Hi Mateo,

Quick note from our engineering lead: the SAML adapter we pulled from your connector repo is hitting a race in the deployment pipeline and has stalled our integration. The team estimates ~5 business days to unblock (root cause is a third-party dependency mismatch).

We were counting on a mid-August pilot demo; with this block we risk not having a working end-to-end to show. Two asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily increase our sandbox hours to cover some extended local testing (we're hitting limits while re-running end-to-end tests)?
- Would Redwood consider a 2-week extension on the trial/pilot window to preserve our demo timeline?

I attached the integration log excerpt and a short stack trace that shows where the deploy runs into timeouts. If you need anything else, I can get the dev who hit the issue on a call.

Appreciate the help — this pilot is one of the few things driving a lot of momentum here.

Thanks,
Dana White
Director of Integrations | NebulaTech
[dana.white@nebulatech.com]

[Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Dana White <dana.white@nebulatech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: integration adapter freeze — request for sandbox hours & trial extension

Hi Dana — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log excerpt. Sorry to hear you ran into the race condition; that kind of intermittent dependency failure is exactly what we want to catch early.

Quick responses:
- I can provision a temporary sandbox hours top-up for NebulaTech today (I will request +750 hours immediately so you can continue testing while engineering digs in).
- For the trial extension, we typically approve 1–2 week make-good extensions for integration blockers; I will loop in Marissa (your CS lead) and Connor (our integration engineer) to confirm scope and timeline and to get a formal approval posted to your HubSpot record.

Connor — can you review the attached log and advise whether we should provide a short workaround (config flag) to get Dana's team past the blocker quickly? If it's a dependency upgrade that we can patch in the connector, estimate time to fix and whether we recommend a patch release or a config workaround.

Marissa — can you start a short mutual action plan entry and flag the docs/approval path for a 2-week trial extension? If we can approve 750 sandbox hours now and sign off on the extension, I’ll follow up with the promo code and the updated pilot end date.

Dana — I’ll confirm the sandbox uplift in a follow-up once I have sign-off, and propose an extension window based on Connor’s ETA. If helpful, we can do a quick triage call this week; I’m free Thur/Fri afternoon PST.

— Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Dana White <dana.white@nebulatech.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:08:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: integration adapter freeze — request for sandbox hours & trial extension

Thanks for looping me in — I pulled the HubSpot record and the usage dashboard. A few operational notes and a proposed path: 

Summary of ask:
- Top-up sandbox hours for NebulaTech to ensure runs while they patch the adapter.
- Short pilot extension so the demo window remains intact.

What I propose (pre-approved by CS ops for integration blockers):
- Immediate sandbox uplift: +750 hours (temporary quota applied to NebulaTech sandbox tenant).
- Pilot extension: provisional +2 weeks from the current pilot end date, pending engineering confirmation that the blocker is the reason for delay.

Connor — can you confirm whether +2 weeks is reasonable if the root-cause patch lands within the next 5 business days? Also advise whether a config workaround would reduce the time to unblock (and what risk that carries).

Dana — I’ve attached a short one-page proposal I’ll use for official sign-off (proposal-digest.pdf). If you’re OK with the wording I’ll route it through finance for the promo exception and post an updated pilot end date once we have Connor’s ETA.

Milestones I’ll track:
1) Sandbox hours applied (target: today)
2) Engineering triage and ETA (Connors to provide)
3) Formal approval and HubSpot note + updated pilot end date

If everyone agrees I’ll action #1 immediately.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: proposal-digest.pdf (1 page)]

From: Dana White <dana.white@nebulatech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 11:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: integration adapter freeze — request for sandbox hours & trial extension

Hi Marissa / Mateo / Connor —

Thanks for the quick turnaround here. Confirming that the +750 sandbox hours will keep our test runs moving while we apply a patch. Our devs implemented a temporary config tweak early today that reduced failure frequency; Connor’s team notes the dependency upgrade is straightforward and we expect a stable patch by end of day Thu (2025-07-31).

We accept the provisional +2 week pilot extension — that aligns us back with the mid-August demo target. Please post the updated pilot end date to HubSpot and send the promo/extension details so our procurement team sees the change.

Next steps for us: send a short post-mortem once the patch is in and validate the connector release with Redwood staging. Happy to do a quick verification call Fri if that helps.

Appreciate the support — this is great momentum.

Best,
Dana White
Director of Integrations | NebulaTech
